Drakenspire Highlands.name: Drakenspire Highlands
Drakenspire Highlands.basicInfo: Drakenspire Highlands covers the capital's two snowy shelves and its surrounding mountain country across the mountain basin. The higher northeastern fortress and crescent of ancestral dragon bones dominate the skyline; the lower shelf holds the busy city. Near slopes support livestock, water infrastructure and maintained approaches. Farther routes reach sparse pines, a frozen basin, working mines, old settlements, caves, Frostback Mountain and isolated creature territories. Places within the fortress precinct are separate playable sites in one coherent complex, not detached castles. The region's existing boundaries contain these expeditions; travel within it does not invent additional regions. The enclosed portalward quarter remains the arrival point from Glowhaven.

Silken Chasm.name: Silken Chasm
Silken Chasm.basicInfo: The upper half of the Silken Descent: a ruined portal chamber above limestone galleries hung with pearl-silver webbing. Cool blue fungi light split stairs, an exposed tension bridge and dry molting alcoves. A main passage curls down the right wall and continues into the Silken Depths at the bottom edge of this map. The portal floor is a refuge; territorial giant spiders occupy the first chamber. This is a close cutaway diagram of a small dungeon, not an overland distance map.

Silken Depths.name: Silken Depths
Silken Depths.basicInfo: The lower half of the same descending cave. The passage enters at the upper edge, widens into turquoise pools and bronze winding gear, then bends down behind a lattice gate toward a circular ember-lit crucible. Silver strands converge on the matron’s apparatus. Arachne defenders use the flooded machinery; Vhalessra holds the lowest chamber. The connecting stairs remain the route back to the upper galleries. Map scale is a close chamber diagram.

Wraith Island Custody District.name: Wraith Island Custody District
Wraith Island Custody District.basicInfo: The controlled prison campus: supervised circulation connects the landing, administrative offices, detention blocks, work and daily-life facilities, and security perimeter. Each facility is a separate location. Legal role, recorded permissions, escort, and actual security determine access.

Cloudbloom Reaches.name: Cloudbloom Reaches
Cloudbloom Reaches.basicInfo: Northwestern broadleaf islands: sunny forest terraces, meadow bowls, hanging roots and pools. Cloudbloom Landing and the small Asterveil Canopy settlement occupy a sheltered satellite near the southeastern edge; most land is woodland and field habitat. Flowering branches shelter maintained walks, while rough outer islands retain predators and dangerous gaps.

Rimeglass Heights.name: Rimeglass Heights
Rimeglass Heights.basicInfo: Northeastern conifer plateaus rise toward snow-lined peaks and blue tarns. Frost forms on exposed ledges even while lower forest folds remain green. Lightning-scarred cliffs and wind-scoured ruins interrupt the pine belt. There is one expedition refuge rather than a second town; marked approaches give way to hunting territories, ice shelves and underground snowmelt channels.

Mirrorwater Marches.name: Mirrorwater Marches
Mirrorwater Marches.basicInfo: Southwestern islands carry interconnected lakes, reed beds, wet forests and waterfalls spilling into the cloud sea. Broad shallow basins alternate with suspended limestone shelves and flooded hollows. The apparent smooth surface conceals channels and rooted mats that cannot bear a traveler. A small anchorage serves survey boats; the surrounding wetlands are largely wild.

Amethyst Crown.name: Amethyst Crown
Amethyst Crown.basicInfo: Southeastern pale-rock islands support violet flowering heath, angular ridges, mineral pools and narrow grassy shelves. Singing stone formations carry wind across the open plateaus. There is no city: a weather shelter marks the practical approach to the frontier. Wildlife here uses sound, concealment and broken sightlines; the innermost crown is an exceptional level-48–55 expedition site, still within the midgame range.

Sepulchral Gardens.name: Sepulchral Gardens
Sepulchral Gardens.basicInfo: A compact abandoned sanctuary of glasshouses, memorial trees and irrigation walks. The portal house is a staging refuge; inner gardens hold plant-bodied undead guardians and an intelligent caretaker. This is a midgame expedition with real retreat routes.

Blackpine March.name: Blackpine March
Blackpine March.basicInfo: Western cedar ridges, hamlets, waterfalls and old roadside shrines. The maintained post road serves everyday journeys; deeper forest hollows have their own occupants.

Thundercrag Highlands.name: Thundercrag Highlands
Thundercrag Highlands.basicInfo: A great terraced quarry and working mine basin below jagged ridges. Stone roads serve inhabited works, while abandoned cuts and high scree are dangerous.

Mount Shiun.name: Mount Shiun
Mount Shiun.basicInfo: The sacred mountain rises behind the capital. Pilgrim lodgings, cedar stairs, pagodas and waterfalls occupy its lower approaches; snow and exposed ridges lie above.

Snowcedar Heights.name: Snowcedar Heights
Snowcedar Heights.basicInfo: Snowbound mountains, blue tarns and isolated conifer valleys. A sheltered pass links the few attended refuges. Glacial basins and ruined watchposts demand preparation.

Mizuhara Lake Country.name: Mizuhara Lake Country
Mizuhara Lake Country.basicInfo: The western castle town and its lakeshore villages share ferries, fish markets and irrigated terraces. The castle is a working seat above a broad landing, not a second national capital.

Bamboo Veil Valleys.name: Bamboo Veil Valleys
Bamboo Veil Valleys.basicInfo: Green bamboo valleys connect the western country with Benitsuru. Mills, bridges, paper workshops and small farms stand along bright tributaries; abandoned groves have less welcoming inhabitants.

Benitsuru Basin.name: Benitsuru Basin
Benitsuru Basin.basicInfo: The capital beneath the sacred mountain: Shogunal castle, canal wards, shrines, guildhall and dense neighborhoods. Its streets are inhabited civic space, with roads radiating toward both castle towns.

Koganedai Terraces.name: Koganedai Terraces
Koganedai Terraces.basicInfo: The eastern castle town stands above gold-leaved terraces, artisan streets, training grounds and timber approaches. House Tsubakiri guards a small imported-device workshop.

Golden Grain Plain.name: Golden Grain Plain
Golden Grain Plain.basicInfo: Working grain fields, paddies, orchards and riverside villages feed the towns. Travelers encounter ordinary farm business as often as trouble; the principal road is maintained.

Mirror-Reed Lowlands.name: Mirror-Reed Lowlands
Mirror-Reed Lowlands.basicInfo: Wooded low ridges, cedar paths and a narrow river descending beneath an arched bridge. Reeds gather along the northern water margin, but most of this province is forest, rocky slopes and clearings. Small hamlets, dye gardens and roadside shrines serve walkers and pack traffic; the principal crossing is a bridge.

Redleaf River Country.name: Redleaf River Country
Redleaf River Country.basicInfo: Maple-red valleys, riverside shrines, guesthouses and broad old bridges. Locals use the main road; wooded side trails and abandoned festival grounds have stranger traffic.

Lanternwood Border.name: Lanternwood Border
Lanternwood Border.basicInfo: Ancient wooded escarpments, waterfalls and shrines among enormous roots. The Soul Torii occupies a reachable lower approach, while the far cedar hollows shelter dangerous beings.

Veiled Cedar Reach.name: Veiled Cedar Reach
Veiled Cedar Reach.basicInfo: Dense fog layers a compact wilderness of cedar roots, wet low ground and an old festival road. The western threshold and Bellroot Refuge are usable staging places. Lantern Marsh and the listening woods lead toward a crane crossing and a more dangerous pale grove. These sites share physical paths; voices and fog do not transport someone without actual movement.

Evertree District.name: Evertree District
Evertree District.basicInfo: The Evertree rises above pale civic buildings, gardens and the northern residential quarter. Broad approaches connect the court, the Cloud District and the great avenue below. Public streets and controlled palace rooms have different access.

Northwest District.name: Northwest District
Northwest District.basicInfo: Green western ridges descend toward the northwestern city wall. Greywatch Keep and the Emberfox pools overlook roads leading to Phoenix Wing and the upper residential streets. The maintained approaches are busy; wooded slopes beyond them grow quieter.

Harbor District.name: Harbor District
Harbor District.basicInfo: Northern shore roads meet the working waterfront and Hydra Head Academy. Cargo sheds, homes, gardens and coastal farms share the approaches to Whitecrest Harbor. Beaconrest Lighthouse marks the offshore channel.

Whitecrest Isles.name: Whitecrest Isles
Whitecrest Isles.basicInfo: Rocky islands and sheltered channels lie beyond the harbor. Saltmere and Driftstone support ordinary island households, while the isolated skull-shaped Wraith Island receives controlled prison traffic. Weather and working boats shape everyday journeys.

Southwest District.name: Southwest District
Southwest District.basicInfo: Western gates, Gryffin Tail and closely fitted residential streets occupy the southwestern city. Rougher Greyfield housing gathers outside the southern walls, beyond which the land rises into pines. Maintained streets remain ordinary civic ground.

Artisan Quarter.name: Artisan Quarter
Artisan Quarter.basicInfo: Founders’ arcades, workshops, inns and the Crucible fill the central southern wards. Timber carts and students share the streets with shoppers and craftspeople. The lower wall separates working neighborhoods from the patched roofs of Greyfield.

Southeast District.name: Southeast District
Southeast District.basicInfo: Dragon Hoard, the eastern residential wards and the south gate overlook shore roads and neighboring farms. Commercial lanes connect the central city with Pebblewick and the coast. Workshops and quiet homes continue between the larger landmarks.

Crescent Coast.name: Crescent Coast
Crescent Coast.basicInfo: Curved beaches and small rocky islands follow the coast south of Whitecrest. Inns, fishers and visiting boats use the sheltered inshore water. Exposed reefs require care even when the nearby beaches are peaceful.

Pinewater Vale.name: Pinewater Vale
Pinewater Vale.basicInfo: Pinewater winds between wooded banks, farm tracks and the lanes around Pebbletown. Caravan staging and a remote alchemical cottage stand near the crossings. Water level, loose banks and ordinary animal activity give practical work to people who know the valley.

Seaward Bluffs.name: Seaward Bluffs
Seaward Bluffs.basicInfo: Forested coastal bluffs give way to open meadows above a winding river. Starlark Abbey offers a settled presence inland, while the Seaward Overlook remains a quiet place to watch the sea. Exposed edges and weather demand sensible footing.

Bluecoil Reach.name: Bluecoil Reach
Bluecoil Reach.basicInfo: Open blue water surrounds distant reefs, the Gilded Albatross anchorage and an isolated serpent resting place. Sailors distinguish ordinary coastal passages from the waters around a sleeping great beast. Sudden swells and scarce landing places reward preparation.

Moonarch Shoals.name: Moonarch Shoals
Moonarch Shoals.basicInfo: Broken island stonework, a stranded wreck and broad shell-shaped rocks interrupt the eastern sea. Fishers know usable approaches and signs of larger creatures passing beneath them. The wreck waters are considerably less forgiving than the sheltered island coves.

Greenrush Marshes.name: Greenrush Marshes
Greenrush Marshes.basicInfo: The river breaks into shallow tidal channels, reed beds and sandbars before meeting the eastern sea. Boatwrights, fishers and field workers use its changing margins. Dry-looking ground can flood quickly with an incoming tide.

Longgrass Meadows.name: Longgrass Meadows
Longgrass Meadows.basicInfo: Wide grasslands stretch between the western forest and the lower river. A few farmsteads and cart tracks leave large areas of open ground. Herding, gathering and ordinary rural travel occupy more of the landscape than ruins or fortifications.

Sunmead Plain.name: Sunmead Plain
Sunmead Plain.basicInfo: Low hills, open pasture and scattered copses fill the southern plain. Thin dirt lanes link homesteads with the river crossings and neighboring meadows. Long sightlines let travelers notice weather, livestock and distant trouble before approaching.

Greenfield Farmlands.name: Greenfield Farmlands
Greenfield Farmlands.basicInfo: Cultivated strips and scattered homesteads spread beyond Greyfield and the city’s southern approaches. Irrigation branches lead toward the wider river country, while wooded margins conceal quieter ground. Farm roads carry produce, laborers and travelers.

Westpine Forest.name: Westpine Forest
Westpine Forest.basicInfo: Pines cover western ridges beside the lower river country. Clear working paths and old crossings skirt denser wildlife habitat. Woodcutters and walkers use the forest without treating every quiet clearing as a monster lair.

Southglade Woods.name: Southglade Woods
Southglade Woods.basicInfo: Southern woodland rises around an old stone lookout and scattered clearings. The outer tracks meet open grazing country; deeper folds of forest shelter wary animals. Old Southwatch can be reached without searching for a secret road.

Brookmeadow Downs.name: Brookmeadow Downs
Brookmeadow Downs.basicInfo: Open downs and the westward village approaches surround a working windmill. A crossroads links the northern road, river bridge and farm lanes. It is settled countryside with room for travelers to pass without becoming part of every local dispute.

Brookmeadow Vale.name: Brookmeadow Vale
Brookmeadow Vale.basicInfo: Brookmeadow’s houses, green and crop plots stand beside a river approach in the southeastern countryside. Farmers, mill customers and visiting workers share the lanes. The village remains a familiar local beginning within Glowhaven’s wider territory.

The Lantern Circuit.name: The Lantern Circuit
The Lantern Circuit.basicInfo: A compact circuit of gardens, workshops and peculiar recreation rooms. Corridors shift around dependable room thresholds, marked stairs and copper lanterns. The household keeps return routes clear.

Crownwater Terraces.name: Crownwater Terraces
Crownwater Terraces.basicInfo: Reservoirs, an aqueduct and cultivated terraces feed the capital's upper waterways. Archives, a noble estate and service households occupy separate plateaus joined by viaducts. Their foundations rest on connected mountain ground; clouds in the lower valleys do not make these floating islands.

Starfall Heights.name: Starfall Heights
Starfall Heights.basicInfo: The western sacred heights hold the cathedral, pilgrim beds, cloister gardens and old burial grounds. White walls, violet roofs and maintained stairs share the terrace with ordinary worshippers and workers. The cathedral is a living institution with internal disagreements, not proof that every citizen serves a secret sect.

The Imperial Crown.name: The Imperial Crown
The Imperial Crown.basicInfo: The great palace occupies the central high terrace above the capital's waterfalls. Its public petition court, diplomatic houses, guard barracks, mint and ceremonial ballroom form related precincts within one royal complex. Private apartments and research cellars have actual guarded access.

High Arcana Ward.name: High Arcana Ward
High Arcana Ward.basicInfo: Spire residences, a court research establishment, an astronomical observatory and mineral intake works step across the northeastern heights. Water and mana infrastructure require maintenance. Public roads and ordinary homes remain distinct from guarded laboratories and the old receiving station.

Violet Market Ward.name: Violet Market Ward
Violet Market Ward.basicInfo: Violet cloth canopies, food stalls, counting rooms and specialist shops surround a working urban market. The queen's public gardens and a private oracle's oratory sit nearby. Commerce, evening company and ordinary household errands continue independently of court intrigues.

Westbridge Ward.name: Westbridge Ward
Westbridge Ward.basicInfo: Bridge approaches, a courthouse, baths, workshops and public sporting grounds fill the western middle terraces. Nobles, laborers, advocates and apprentices use the same streets for different purposes. The amphitheatre supports announced performances and bouts without turning every visitor into a contestant.

Celestial Ward.name: Celestial Ward
Celestial Ward.basicInfo: A great celestial monument overlooks the central civic avenue. The capital's institute, city watch, public records, theatre and international Adventurer's Guild branch serve a dense inhabited district. Court affiliation is influential but does not make every official, scholar or guild worker privy to royal secrets.

Eastwater Ward.name: Eastwater Ward
Eastwater Ward.basicInfo: Lock gates, bonded storage, craft lanes and crowded homes follow the eastern waterways. Freight and pedestrian routes cross on arched bridges. Private clubs and workshops provide legitimate work alongside opportunities for smuggling and exploitation; the entire neighborhood is not a criminal camp.

Windmill Escarpment.name: Windmill Escarpment
Windmill Escarpment.basicInfo: Small windmills, granaries, orchards and a working hamlet occupy the outer southwestern terrace. Quarry paths and an old culvert lie away from the maintained road. Modest jobs and ordinary rural business are accessible before harder, deliberately chosen work below the cliffs.

Kingsward Gate.name: Kingsward Gate
Kingsward Gate.basicInfo: The monumental land gate receives road travelers beneath the capital's southern walls. Hostels, tea rooms, caravan yards and a controlled portal hall support arrivals. Road admission, guild membership and permission to cross the Evertree network are separate matters.

Southbank Ward.name: Southbank Ward
Southbank Ward.basicInfo: Dense southern homes, a local school, bakery, common eating house and repair trades sit behind the lower walls. Small courts and shared stairs connect residents whose lives are not organized around the palace. A guarded remand house belongs to local law, not Glowhaven's Wraith Island system.

Lantern Harbors.name: Lantern Harbors
Lantern Harbors.basicInfo: Deep lower harbors and island channels receive ships beneath the city terraces. Customs arcades, shipwrights, working docks and navigation lights serve coastal and imperial traffic. Skiffs reach a few offshore places; exposed water and a wreck support optional prepared work.
